setup.definition: At exact 15m OPEN, fresh transition to >=N breached upper BBs across 7 TFs using BB(20,2). Freeze breached-band prices at setup.

confirmations.RED_CLOSE: First completed 15m candle after setup with close < open.
confirmations.BREAK_PREV_LOW: First completed 15m candle after setup with close < previous 15m low.
confirmations.REENTER_NEAREST: First completed 15m candle after setup with close <= frozen nearest breached upper BB.
confirmations.REENTER_AND_BREAK_LOW: First completed 15m candle after setup satisfying REENTER_NEAREST and close < previous 15m low.

entry: Next 15m OPEN after confirmation; no same-bar clairvoyance.
target_definition: Frozen setup-time breached upper BB rank; far1=farthest, far2=second farthest, far3=third farthest.
chronology: Use official Binance 1m for TP/SL collision resolution on executable trade; same 1m both => loss.
selection_rule: Use this pass to identify robust confirmation families. No live promotion from same scan.
entry_validity: For each target variant, exclude if that frozen target was touched at any time from setup bar through the confirmation bar before the next-bar entry.
